links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: An industry qualifies as a target only if it is network-shaped and already buys consultancy
content:
The requirements are stated as a conjunction: the industry must be "sufficiently decentralized, 'network shaped'" and must have "an established consultancy market with projects" that are both high-value and capable of helping establish PMF.

Decentralization matters because a network-shaped industry has many independent parties who must agree on records — which is the condition under which an attributed, shared record has value. A concentrated industry solves the same problem internally with a single vendor.

The consultancy-market requirement is the one that does the filtering in practice. It is what disqualified construction despite an otherwise strong fit, and it is why the criterion is about buyer behaviour rather than technical need: an industry can need the capability and still have no route to sell it.
description: Four criteria: sufficiently decentralized, an established consultancy market, projects that are high-value, and projects that can help establish product-market fit.
